architecture_summary: The repository implements a dual-chain (Solana + EVM) trading bot with a Strategy Laboratory pattern. New strategies start in SHADOW, require a minimum number of evaluation windows and trades, and can only be promoted after measured out-of-sample evidence. Execution safety gates (simulation/preflight, slippage, sellability, liquidity checks, circuit breakers) are structurally present. AI proposals are validated against a schema that blocks credential and deployment-instruction injection.

proposals.name: Profitable-wallet cohort momentum signal
proposals.hypothesis: Tokens that appear repeatedly in the recent buy history of a cohort of independently profitable wallets (each verifiably net-positive over >= 30 days, money-weighted) exhibit short-term positive price momentum sufficient to recover round-trip costs on at least 55% of eligible trades.
proposals.differentiation: Uses a multi-wallet cohort rather than a single leader; the signal is the intersection of independently profitable behaviour, not a copy of one wallet's positions.

evidence.note: Strategy Lab SHADOW infrastructure exists and enforces MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR, MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION, and MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES before promotion.
Cross-chain signal adapter layer present, supporting both Solana and EVM; entry point for new signal families.
AI proposal ingestion validates schema and blocks credential/deployment injection. Multi-wallet cohort proposal would pass schema validation.

proposals.shadow_test: Register strategy with SHADOW status; after >= 8 trades across >= 3 evaluation windows on each chain, measure money-weighted net P&L after fees/gas/slippage. Falsified if profit_factor < 1.10 or eligible-opportunity participation < 0.20.
proposals.research_plan: 1. Use Dune to build a cohort of >= 20 wallets with verifiable 30-day net-positive money-weighted P&L on both Solana and EVM. 2. Identify tokens present in >= 3 cohort wallets' recent buys within a 4-hour window. 3. Shadow-simulate entry/exit on those tokens for 2 weeks. 4. Compare simulated gross P&L against estimated round-trip costs (DEX fees, gas, slippage from Jupiter/DEX Screener quotes).

proposals.name: New-liquidity quality filter for early-pool tokens
proposals.hypothesis: Tokens whose liquidity pools are <= 6 hours old, have >= $50k locked liquidity, pass sellability simulation, show >= 3x volume-to-liquidity ratio within the first hour, and whose deployer address has no prior rug-pull association exhibit a short-term positive net edge after costs in at least 50% of shadow trades.
proposals.differentiation: Focuses on objective, measurable pool-quality metrics rather than leader-wallet copying. Does not rely on any single wallet's behaviour.

evidence.note: Pool-age, liquidity and sellability checks are referenced as standard execution gates; the strategy would compose these existing checks into a novel entry filter.
Fast-market module exists, suggesting low-latency market data is available for new-pool detection.

proposals.shadow_test: Register strategy with SHADOW status. For each qualifying new pool, record shadow entry/exit and measure net P&L after fees. Falsified if profit_factor < 1.10 after >= 10 eligible opportunities, or if >= 30% of trades result in exit failure or sellability gate block.
proposals.research_plan: 1. Use DEX Screener API to identify new pools meeting age, liquidity and volume criteria on Solana and EVM. 2. Cross-reference deployer addresses against known rug-pull lists (Dune, public blocklists). 3. Run 2-week shadow simulation. 4. Measure slippage, gas/priority cost and actual exit prices versus simulated.

proposals.name: Existing SHADOW strategies: extend evaluation window
proposals.hypothesis: Any SHADOW strategy in the registry that has fewer than the minimum required evaluation windows (MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS=3) or fewer than MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES=8 should continue to accumulate shadow evidence before any promotion decision is made.
proposals.differentiation: Not a new strategy; a governance recommendation to prevent premature promotion.

evidence.note: MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS=3 and MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES=8 are defined. Without runtime evidence it cannot be confirmed whether any SHADOW strategy currently meets these thresholds.

proposals.shadow_test: Confirm via strategy_lab_windows query that each SHADOW strategy has completed >= 3 evaluation windows and >= 8 trades before any promotion candidate review. Falsified if a strategy is promoted before these thresholds are met.
proposals.research_plan: Query strategy_lab_windows for all SHADOW strategies at source commit. Report evaluation window count, trade count, profit factor and eligible-participation rate per strategy.
